goal: Prevent silent connection failures to IPv6 peers when routing through SOCKS5 proxies like Tor
Tor exit relays misparse compressed IPv6 addresses, dropping connections with no fallback
agreement: Strong support with testing and no open objections
Verified by testing that it resolves proxy connection failures to IPv6 peers (andrewtoth)
Concept approval after confirming upstream Tor bug status (darosior)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it restores connectivity to 20% to 50% of reachable IPv6 peers when routing through Tor
Connections to addresses with compressed notation currently fail silently with no fallback
